The GrowthCred field guide

Stalled video courses or shared team habits: live vs recorded AI training.

A library of recorded videos often stalls on your busy week. Your staff leave with different habits.

A live session on your real work gets everyone practising the same check together.

Quick answer

GrowthCred does not sell a recorded training video. A person still checks the draft.

4 min read

You'll learn

  1. You see where a recorded course stalls for your team, and where a live session builds one shared habit.
  2. You see how to pick the format without buying videos your team will not finish.

Why listen to GrowthCred

GrowthCred is a Johannesburg AI implementation and training company. I teach AI at Melsoft Academy. I helped build an isiZulu and English speech AI system. It was presented at Parliament in Cape Town.

1Recorded videos often stall when the week gets busy

The problem

  1. Videos, slides and quizzes you leave for when people have time often sit unfinished once your normal work takes over.
  2. Generic examples ignore your documents, your POPIA duties and who signs your work. A video cannot answer when someone asks you if a file is safe to try.

The way through

  1. A solo after-hours video can suit you if you will finish it. Watching alone often leaves your team with uneven habits.
  2. You choose a shared working format when your whole team needs the same safe routine.

A video can sit unfinished. Your live working session cannot.

2Live sessions let the whole team test real tasks at once

The problem

  1. Your people who watch separate videos can leave with clashing habits on drafting, checking and confidentiality.
  2. If you pull the whole team away at once, you can leave a desk, a field role or a shift short.

The way through

  1. You bring the team together live, in Johannesburg or online. You practise on real reports, notes, summaries or routine admin. Someone is there to fix a bad draft. A person still reviews what goes out.
  2. You run smaller groups, or you rotate staff, so your field and frontline cover stays in place.

When your team trains live together, your managers and your staff leave with one shared rule.

3Match the format to the person or the group you are training

The problem

  1. A pile of videos rarely gives your team one habit. A full team session is the wrong buy if you are one owner alone.
  2. If you expect a speed gain before you time the work, and before your habit sticks, you will be disappointed.

The way through

  1. You use live corporate training, in Johannesburg or online, when your team needs one shared habit. We quote it per person after a short call. Or you use the one-day online owner workshop, at the R990 founding rate, when you want one live day alone.
  2. You skip a background video if you want your team lined up. GrowthCred does not sell recorded training videos. You measure any speed gain against your own baseline, and against whether your habit stays.

You do not have to buy a pile of videos to get a working habit.

Ask for a quote

4Keep a clear line on who we are and what the training covers

The problem

  1. Practical training is not an accredited qualification. A session does not replace your formal policies.
  2. A similar name, or a lending service, is a different company.

The way through

  1. You treat the session as hands-on training. A person still checks every draft. It is not an accredited qualification.
  2. GrowthCred (Pty) Ltd operates from Rosebank, Johannesburg. Phila Ngwenya is the founder. We are not Growth Credit Ltd. We do not lend money.

The teams that move are the ones who practise on your real work, then you check every draft.

Want the team to build one shared habit, rather than watch separate videos? Ask for a quote after a short call. We plan around the group size and the desk cover, so you do not have to empty the office.

If you only want one live day for yourself, take the online workshop at the R990 founding rate. You do not have to buy a library of recorded videos you will not finish.

A video can sit unfinished. A live day cannot.

Want the team practising together in one live session? Ask for a quote.

Frequently asked questions

Should a team choose live AI training or a recorded video course?+
A live session is the better fit for your team. Your people work on real tasks at the same time and leave with one shared rule and a human review. Solo videos often stall and leave you with uneven habits. GrowthCred does not sell you recorded training videos.
How much do live team training and the owner workshop cost?+
Live corporate team training is quoted per person after a short call. It runs in Johannesburg or online. Your one-day online workshop is R990 at the founding rate. Neither is an accredited course.
